## LinkedIn prospect search

This paid, read-only tool searches Crustdata's indexed professional-person dataset for up to ten possible prospects. It requires explicit approval for a maximum 0.30-credit search, uses reviewed professional filters, ranks the returned rows locally, and exposes only public professional fields. It never returns contact data, paginates, retries, or claims anyone is a qualified buyer.
